title: SOS: DELETE silent-drop gates have zero test coverage
description: Found by codereview (edge pass) on b7z9.121.3. emergency.py render_delete 的 6 个静默丢弃分支(empty payload/missing envelope/bad sig blob/non-originator key/invalid sig/replay, ~L334-366)无任何测试;_expect_silent_drop 硬编码 POST 无法复用,需加 code/uri 参数或 DELETE 专用断言。回归(如恢复 4.01、idle 检查顺序变化)不会被发现。
